description: Report whether a help_id from aether_find actually helped. Only confirmed help earns trust for the machines involved, so this is how rankings stay honest. Free.

helpful.description: true if a returned machine solved your need, false otherwise.

note.description: Optional short note on what worked or failed.

peer_id.description: Optional. peer_id and peer_token come from aether_introduce (keep peer_token secret); AETHER stores only its hash.

peer_token.description: Optional. Secret token paired with peer_id.

name: aether_confirm_help
title: Confirm whether a result helped
